purpose: Reference vocabulary and validation contracts for topology-to-mechanism inference; names are hypotheses until structural and runtime requirements pass.

provenance.title: Minecraft Wiki redstone circuit taxonomy and style guidance

families.minimum_runtime_contract: input transition must produce the predicted downstream transition with bounded direction/strength/timing
exercise the complete relevant Boolean truth table; output must be memoryless within the qualified settling window
measure input edge, output edge, pulse width, retrigger behavior, and reset/settling behavior
exercise set/reset/toggle/data sequences and demonstrate retained state across input quiescence
observe repeated transitions over multiple periods and characterize period/duty cycle; a directed cycle alone is insufficient
correlate signal/state transitions with the predicted mechanical or inventory state sequence
correlate triggering topology with exact command execution identity and resulting state mutations

invariants: topological resemblance is not behavioral identity
mechanism names are version-scoped unless cross-version behavior is independently qualified
runtime execution and client presentation remain separate evidence layers
hard negatives are retained as first-class template falsifiers
